sourceFacts.claim: llx_societe stores a third party name and separate code_client and code_fournisseur fields.
llx_societe has a parent field and keeps customer and supplier codes on the same llx_societe row.
Societe::create creates a third party in the database and returns a nonnegative result on success or a negative result on failure.
Thirdparties::post validates request_data, copies checked fields to Societe, calls Societe::create, and returns the created company id.
Societe::$client uses 0=no customer, 1=customer, 2=prospect, 3=customer and prospect; $fournisseur uses 0=no supplier and 1=supplier.
Successful Societe creation calls the COMPANY_CREATE trigger unless triggers are disabled.
Societe parameter verification requires a nonempty name and checks customer-code syntax, requirement, uniqueness, and prefix conditions when client is set.
llx_societe has a primary rowid, entity defaults to 1 and is NOT NULL, and status denotes active or closed/not open.
A duplicate Societe database record yields ErrorCompanyNameAlreadyExists and a negative result; other database failure uses the database error.
Thirdparties::put fetches the Societe, updates it, and on success returns Thirdparties::get for the same id.
The Thirdparties API exposes get(id) and GET email/{email} read boundaries returning cleaned Societe data.
The llx_societe SQL comment describes client as 0/1/2 while Societe::$client separately documents 0..3, so the captured native sources conflict on the documented client value range.
llx_product stores ref, label, prices, tosell, tobuy, tobatch and fk_product_type; fk_product_type 0 is regular product and 1 is service.
llx_product carries fk_default_warehouse, fk_default_bom, fk_default_workstation, fk_unit and fk_project references.
Product::create creates a product/service and returns its id on success or a negative value on failure.
Products::post validates request_data, checks fields, calls Product::create and returns the Product id.
llx_product uses tosell and tobuy flags, tobatch, and fk_product_type values 0 regular product, 1 service, and 9 other.
Successful Product creation calls the PRODUCT_CREATE trigger unless triggers are disabled.
Product::create requires label and ref; missing label records ErrorMandatoryParametersNotProvided.
llx_product requires ref, entity and label, with rowid as primary key and entity defaulting to 1.
Products::put rejects id below 1, missing rights, missing Product, denied resource access, and direct stock_reel update through this boundary.
After successful Products::put, the API returns Products::get(id).
The Products API exposes get(id) and GET ref/{ref} read boundaries.
llx_product labels stock as DENORMALIZED, fifo and lifo as TODO/not used, and hidden as not used/deprecated; these fields do not establish active operations in the captured profile.
llx_commande stores an order header with ref, ref_client, fk_soc, dates, author/modifier/validator/closer users and fk_statut.
llx_commandedet rows relate to llx_commande through fk_commande and may relate to fk_parent_line and fk_product.
Commande::valid validates an order, optionally using an idwarehouse, and returns negative on failure, zero when nothing is done, or positive on success.
Commande::addline takes native desc, pu_ht, qty, tax, product, discount, date, type, unit, origin and reference inputs for an order line.
Commande statuses are STATUS_CANCELED=-1, STATUS_DRAFT=0, STATUS_VALIDATED=1, STATUS_SHIPMENTONPROCESS=2 and STATUS_CLOSED=3.
Successful validation calls the ORDER_VALIDATE trigger unless triggers are disabled.
Commande::valid does nothing when status is already STATUS_VALIDATED.
llx_commande requires ref, entity and fk_soc; rowid is primary key and fk_statut defaults to 0.
Orders::_fetch rejects missing read right, absent ID/ref/ref_ext, missing order and denied commande resource access with REST errors.
GET {id}/lines fetches the Commande, checks read/resource access, loads getLinesArray and returns cleaned order lines.
The Orders API exposes GET {id}/lines and GET {id}/lines/{lineid}.
STATUS_ACCEPTED=2 is retained only for backward compatibility and deprecated in favor of STATUS_SHIPMENTONPROCESS=2; the same stored value has two native constant names.
